purpose: Tracks, per G20+ expansion candidate, whether each required source-authority category has an official source identified and/or verified on file. This file records research state only. It never grants publication status — that happens exclusively through the existing data/rules/<slug>.json six-gate pipeline.

intake_status_model_notes.not_started: No candidate authority has been identified for this category yet.
intake_status_model_notes.identified: A plausible official authority name is known (public knowledge), but no specific official source URL has been fetched, dated, or cited yet.
intake_status_model_notes.needs_verification: A source URL exists from prior internal research but has not been re-checked for current reachability/effective text under this intake process.
intake_status_model_notes.verified_on_file: A specific official source URL is already recorded in the corresponding data/rules/<slug>.json source_authorities and was live-verified during that entry's own research (per the existing six-gate pipeline) — restated here for tracking only, not re-verified by this file.
intake_status_model_notes.not_applicable: This source category is not currently believed to be needed for this candidate's currency-passage rules (starting assumption only, may change once research begins).

not_applicable_note: tax_treasury_ministry_source is marked not_applicable for every candidate below because no candidate in this G20+ intake round has an identified currency-passage rule that depends specifically on a tax/treasury/ministry source distinct from its central bank or customs authority. This may change during actual research; not_applicable is a starting assumption, not a permanent exclusion.

central_bank_or_monetary_authority.label: Banco de México (Banxico) + Comisión de Cambios (SHCP + Banxico) — market-determined free-floating exchange regime
central_bank_or_monetary_authority.note: P8G-1 live-verified 2026-07-25: Mexico operates a market-determined FREE-FLOATING exchange regime since 22 Dec 1994, with the exchange-rate regime set by the Comisión de Cambios (officials of the SHCP and Banco de México). Confirmed via the official SHCP 'Anuncio de la Comisión de Cambios' (gob.mx/shcp, HTTP 200) and Banco de México (banxico.org.mx, HTTP 200; some deep pages WAF-block the fetch bot). SCOPE: this verifies the exchange-rate-determination MECHANISM only; it does NOT by itself establish the presence or absence of any general exchange-control, approval, or capital-movement restriction. FINDING: the on-file data/rules/mexico.json control claims (country_overview 'capital flow management measures'; summary.business 'Banxico approval'; resident_holding_rules 'Banxico limits and approval requirements'; take/summary.traveler 'export restricted / Banxico limits') are UNSUPPORTED by the P8G-1 sources and require claim-specific verification or removal at P8G-2 — not replacement with an equally unsupported 'no controls' assertion. Whether any general exchange-control/approval restriction exists is a P8G-2 verification target; exact FX legal basis (Ley del Banco de México / Ley Monetaria; Comisión de Cambios; Banxico circulars) to be pinned then. DISTINCT from customs declaration, from bank USD-cash-deposit caps, and from UIF AML. P8G-2 done 2026-07-29 (first CRES application): FX legal basis pinned to Ley del Banco de México Art. 21-22 (Comisión de Cambios) and Ley Monetaria Art. 8 (foreign currency not legal tender; FX obligations settled in pesos at the exchange rate); mexico.json content corrected per CRES §7 — the on-file over-statements removed and recorded as unsupported, NOT replaced with an unsupported 'no controls' absolute; the exhaustive absence of controls outside the examined statutes recorded as a bounded verification item. Review-Gate corrections before merge (2026-07-29): the no-authorisation-regime claim downgraded to E2 bounded (a bounded review finding, not a legal negative); resident_holding_rules and non_resident_rules converted to CRES E3 verification targets (sources do not establish account eligibility/operation/repatriation); deferred AML numeric detail removed until P8G-2b; the unsourced '1982 decree superseded' statement removed; the exchange-rate-regime grading kept claim-level, with Comisión de Cambios statutory authority independently E0 but the composite current free-floating regime claim recorded as E1 rather than any hybrid E0/E1. page_status stays verified; no public surface; Mexico held at source_review_ready.

customs_or_border_authority.label: ANAM (Agencia Nacional de Aduanas de México) — traveller cash declaration under Ley Aduanera Art. 9o (SAT-approved forms)
customs_or_border_authority.note: P8G-1 live-verified 2026-07-25 against the current official Ley Aduanera (diputados.gob.mx PDF, HTTP 200; Nueva Ley DOF 15-12-1995, última reforma DOF 19-11-2025). Art. 9o (verbatim): any person entering or leaving national territory carrying cash, national or foreign checks, payment orders or any other collectible document, or a COMBINATION, EXCEEDING the equivalent of ten thousand USD, is obliged to declare it to the customs authorities on SAT-approved forms — symmetric entry AND exit; second paragraph covers international valuables-transport/courier shipments above the same threshold. Penalty: Art. 185 fracción VII — fine of 20% to 40% of the amount exceeding USD 10,000. Operational authority is ANAM (decree DOF 14-07-2021, operational 2022); forms remain SAT-approved. anam.gob.mx WAF-blocks the bot (HTTP 403) but the ANAM 'Declaración de dinero' guidance and Art. 9 text are confirmed via official search and the diputados primary law. FINDING: on-file cash_declaration_threshold/bring/take fields need tightening to 'exceeding USD 10,000', the full instrument list, and ANAM authority at P8G-2. DISTINCT from FX regulation, bank reporting, UIF AML, and LFPIORPI domestic cash-payment limits.

financial_intelligence_unit_or_aml_autho.label: Unidad de Inteligencia Financiera (UIF), Secretaría de Hacienda y Crédito Público (gob.mx/hacienda/uif)
financial_intelligence_unit_or_aml_autho.note: P8G-1 identified 2026-07-25: UIF is Mexico's financial intelligence unit for AML/CFT (PLD/CFT) — receives and analyses reports of operations from financial institutions and suspicious-transaction reports; official page gob.mx/hacienda/uif live (HTTP 200). AML context ONLY — non-blocking for the currency-passage rules (which rest on Ley Aduanera customs + Banxico/Comisión de Cambios FX framework). A claim-specific UIF / LFPIORPI (Ley Antilavado) citation is needed only if AML-reporting fields are added at P8G-2, and must NOT be conflated with the customs declaration or with exchange controls.

tax_treasury_ministry_source.note: P8G-1: no SAT tax rule directly gates currency passage; the LFPIORPI domestic cash-PAYMENT limits on certain high-value transactions are a separate AML-linked regime (to keep distinct from the border cash declaration), not a currency-passage tax source. Remains not_applicable for this intake.
